title: Red Team Thinking
prompt:
Act as a Red Team adversary. Your job is to find every weakness in the following plan and
try to destroy it.
Be thorough, critical, and honest. Do not be polite.
The plan                         :  [DESCRIBE YOUR STRATEGY, PRODUCT, OR DECISION]
Our key assumptions  :  [LIST THE THINGS THAT MUST BE TRUE FOR THIS PLAN TO 
                                            WORK]
Attack this plan from four angles:
STRATEGIC ATTACK        :  Why is the direction fundamentally wrong? What are we
misreading about the market?
EXECUTION ATTACK       :  Why will we fail to implement this? Where is our team not
capable enough?
COMPETITIVE ATTACK  :  How will competitors neutralise this? What move could make 
                                                this irrelevant?
ASSUMPTION ATTACK   :  Which single assumption, if wrong, kills the entire plan?
End with: the one attack I should be most afraid of.
Red Team Thinking Process
Identify Weaknesses Simulate Attacks Gather Feedback Prioritize Fixes
PRO TIP
Ask AI to play devil's advocate on your most confident belief about your business. Not
your uncertainties, your certainties. The assumptions you are most sure about are the
ones least likely to be tested. That is exactly what makes them dangerous. Red Team your
strongest convictions quarterly.
